name: himalaya-mcp
description: MCP server wrapping himalaya CLI for privacy-first email access in Claude

scripts.build:cli: esbuild src/cli/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=dist/cli/index.js --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:bundle: npm run build:cli && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js --format=esm --minify && mkdir -p himalaya-mcp-plugin/dist && cp dist/index.js himalaya-mcp-plugin/dist/index.js

author: Data-Wise
